<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:3:5">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>סיעת ל׳</he> a troop of irreligious people; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 688:1">Yalk. Ps. 688</cite> <he>חדא סיעה דל׳</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 112b:3">Pes. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>דל׳ הוו וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>דאינשי ל׳ נינהו</he>) for they are scoffers, and may draw thee into scoffing habits.
